scope: Catalogue SELECT policies only; no user records inspected. Management visibility is not anonymous or Pro-session proof.

select_policies.using:
((is_pro = false) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles
  WHERE ((profiles.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ((profiles.tier = 'pro'::text) OR (profiles.pro_trial_until > now()) OR (COALESCE(profiles.subscription_status, ''::text) = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'trialing'::text])))))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM cipher_coin_unlocks
  WHERE ((cipher_coin_unlocks.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (cipher_coin_unlocks.unlock_type = 'pbq'::text) AND (cipher_coin_unlocks.resource_id = pbqs.id)))))
